scope: Source trace for ordinary-buffer compute on Alder Lake-S 8086:4680; this inventory is not proof that hardware execution works

interfaces.kernel: i915_getparam.c:i915_getparam_ioctl; i915_driver.c driver flags and ioctl table
interfaces.finding: WAIT_TIMEOUT, EXECBUF2, SOFTPIN, EXEC_FENCE_ARRAY, ASYNC, CAPTURE and TIMELINE_FENCES have implemented query cases; driver declares internal SYNCOBJ/TIMELINE and render-allowed execbuffer/context/VM ioctls. A true capability reply alone is not proof of lower-path completion.

interfaces.kernel: i915_gem_vm_create_ioctl; i915_gem_context_create_ioctl -> create_setparam -> set_proto_ctx_param -> VM/ENGINES/RECOVERABLE setters
interfaces.finding: VM-control path first creates the VM, then queue creation creates its engine context; returning from setup_context after VM creation is intentional. Probe selects a compute-capable render queue, supported by Alder Lake-S RCS0. Native allocation/locking and actual target context creation still require validation.

interfaces.operation: Ordinary GEM allocation and PAT extension compatibility
interfaces.finding: Successful memory-region queries enable CREATE_EXT with system-memory placements. ADL does not set has_set_pat_uapi; therefore it does not send SET_PAT, which this kernel only accepts for graphics 12.70+. Protected-context and external-FD paths are not requested by the ordinary probe.

interfaces.operation: Physical backing to device-visible DMA addresses
interfaces.finding: Real page addresses are mapped per S/G range. No-IOMapper path validates identity DMA addresses; IOMapper path uses prepared IODMACommand and checks complete segment length/address mask. ADL-S has a 39-bit DMA mask. Actual device/IOMMU reachability and cache visibility are not proved by source tracing.

Persistent shmem pin and GEM/VMA reference survive native mapping; native unmap precedes unpin and close. Existing actual mapping fixture covers this lifetime. Native physical-page mapping and WB/WC alias/cache semantics remain a separate review/target requirement.

interfaces.kernel: gem/i915_gem_execbuffer.c:i915_gem_execbuffer2_ioctl -> i915_gem_do_execbuffer -> context/engine/VMA selection -> request creation -> eb_submit -> eb_requests_add
interfaces.finding: Object arrays, softpin offsets, per-context engine index and internal syncobj/timeline extensions reach real request creation and submission code. Copy/dispatch transport has its separate native fixture. submission-interface-review.json now records seven source-verified edges (MMIO cache attribute, access width, barriers, ELSQ submit registers, context-image ordering, fence-array path, request/fence order); ring space, GGTT/HWSP address agreement, forcewake ACK and GPU consumption remain open.

Probe uploads changing inputs, submits real compute commands, waits a fence, invalidates noncoherent memory when necessary and compares every output word across changing seeds. COMPUTE_READBACK_VERIFIED precedes teardown; only actual exit 0 plus source/binary/target submission evidence can satisfy acceptance. No such target result exists.

additional_review_items: Explicit preempt scopes: stats/seqcount short sections, CSB fallback repaired, PCODE long retry being adapted; FPU critical exclusion preserved
Native physical page mappings/cache aliases: pmap_change_attr returns success without changing the existing cached kernel view; do not infer CPU/GPU coherency solely from that result
IODMACommand uses system IOMapper while target EFI disables IOMapper; cover both branches in software and verify actual target configuration before claiming DMA success
Complete GPU VA/page-table emission and real request/IRQ/fence/cache/cleanup transitive review before a new hardware request
